cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream
for name, text in [("LF","X=1\nY=2\n"),("CRLF","X=1\r\nY=2\r\n"),("CR","X=1\rY=2\r")]:
    rows=list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    print(name, "expected start lines [1,2] ->", [r.original.line for r in rows])
# what a naive "\n".count would do per consumed chunk
chunks = ["X=1\r\n", "Y=2\n", "Z=3\r"]
for c in chunks:
    print(repr(c), "len\\n-count:", c.count("\n"), "lone-\\r:", c.count("\r"), "real newlines:", len(__import__("re").findall(r"\r\n|\n|\r", c)))
EOF

import io, re
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream, _newline, _end_of_line, _rest_of_line
print("_newline pattern:", _newline.pattern)
# CRLF on the error path: does _rest_of_line consume CRLF atomically?
for t in ["X=1\r\n!!!bad\r\nY=2\r\n"]:
